name: xyz.tantrafiles/wiser
title: Wiser: an open directory of the wisdom traditions
description: Open, read-only directory of the world’s wisdom traditions: traditions, teachers and lineages, places to practise with published contacts, free texts, practices and talks. Every record has a canonical URL, source_url, verified_on and confidence.

tools.name: search
tools.title: Search Wiser
tools.description: Search the Wiser directory: teachers, scholars and figures, traditions and schools, topics, practices, texts and books, collections, places to practise and talks. Returns {results:[{id,title,url}]}; pass an id to fetch (or to the get_* tools) for the full record with source_url, verified_on and confidence.

tools.name: get_topic
tools.title: Topic hub
tools.description: A topic seen across traditions: intro, sub-questions, one-line takes per tradition, the best talks chosen for diversity across traditions (MMR), practices, texts, teachers and related topics.

tools.name: get_teacher
tools.title: Teacher, scholar or figure
tools.description: A person profile: bio, years, traditions, works, their best talks, talks about them, lineage neighbours and places tied to them.

tools.name: get_lineage
tools.title: Lineage
tools.description: Walk teacher-student (dharma) and/or academic lineage edges up and down from a person or tradition. Every edge carries its confidence.

tools.name: list_practices
tools.title: Practices
tools.description: Practices (meditation, visualisation, enquiry, chant, ritual, movement) with steps in plain words, sources and cautions. Filter by tradition, kind or topic.

tools.name: get_collection
tools.title: Collection
tools.description: A curated set, journey, meditation series, visualisation cycle or syllabus with its ordered units and items. Omit id to list collections.

tools.name: recommend
tools.title: Recommend
tools.description: Stateless recommendations. Give ids the listener liked (clip ids, person/<id>, topic/<id>, tradition/<id>) and optionally disliked; returns diverse talks (taste x quality, MMR across traditions) and next topics to explore (graph neighbours + information gain). With no likes it returns a cold-start spread.

tools.name: fetch
tools.title: Fetch a record
tools.description: Fetch one Wiser record by the id returned from search (e.g. "person/ajahn-chah", "place/tassajara", "resource/the-truth-of-rebirth-...", "topic/rebirth") or its tantrafiles.xyz URL. Returns {id, title, text, url, metadata}; text is a readable summary, metadata carries kind, source_url, verified_on, confidence and licence.

tools.name: find_places
tools.title: Find places to practise
tools.description: Monasteries, retreat centres, ashrams, temples, study centres and sacred sites. Filter by tradition (includes its schools), school (exact), country (ISO code or name), region, type, status (active or heritage), living_teacher, and offers (e.g. "residential", "10-day", "ordination", "online", "sanskrit"; all must match). Every result carries source_url, verified_on and confidence.

tools.name: get_place
tools.title: Place details
tools.description: One place with contacts exactly as the place publishes them (each with its source page and check date), programmes with an as-of date and schedule links, founders/tied teachers, sister monasteries, events, free resources, coordinates, website, source_url, verified_on, confidence and the canonical tantrafiles.xyz URL.

tools.name: find_teachers
tools.title: Find teachers, scholars and figures
tools.description: People in Wiser filtered by tradition (includes schools), school (exact), living (true = living or likely living; status and its basis are returned), country/region (via places they founded or are tied to), role (teacher, scholar, figure) and on_video. Sorted by depth of talks on Wiser.

tools.name: get_resources
tools.title: Texts and books
tools.description: Texts, books and libraries per tradition, person or topic. access = free (publisher’s own free edition, linked never rehosted), paid-or-unknown (published works not known to be free), or no-link. Filter free=true for free reading only.

tools.name: get_lineage_path
tools.title: Lineage path between two people
tools.description: Shortest documented chain between two people (or traditions) over teacher-student, ordination, transmission, academic supervision and influence edges. Each step says who taught/influenced whom, with confidence and a source link where recorded.

tools.name: what_to_study
tools.title: Study path for a tradition
tools.description: A study path for one tradition or school: orientation, then free online resources (texts, practices with cautions, journeys, best talks), then teachers (living first), then places to go (active, residential first, with verified contacts first). Every item carries source_url, verified_on, confidence and a canonical URL.
